## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Spain Galicia Crop fields](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_ga) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. The files here are no longer updated.

# Field boundaries for Spain Galicia

Provides 4963127 official field boundaries from Spain Galicia
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Xunta de Galicia - Oficina Virtual del Medio Rural.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Xunta de Galicia - Oficina Virtual del Medio Rural](https://ovmediorural.xunta.gal/es/consultas-publicas/sixpac)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-4.0 (See https://mapas.xunta.gal/gl/aviso-legal , https://medioambiente.xunta.gal/seccion-organizacion/c/CMAOT_Instituto_Estudos_Territorio?content=Direccion_Xeral_Sostibilidade_Paisaxe/Informacion_publica/seccion.html&std=pgcix_2022_2025.html)
- **Projection:** EPSG:25829
